description.text: The eighth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 24 September 2021, which brought a new battle style, Fusion Strike, beside Single Strike and Rapid Strike: Fusion Strike cards are made to be played together, powering up their allies and weakening the opponent. Mew VMAX leads it: its attack uses any attack of a Fusion Strike Pokémon on its player's Bench for just two Colorless Energy. Genesect V, whose Ability draws until its player's hand matches their number of Fusion Strike Pokémon, Hoopa V, Chandelure VMAX, Boltund VMAX and Greedent VMAX join it, with the Supporters Elesa's Sparkle and Chili & Cilan & Cress and Fusion Strike Energy, which counts as any type. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Mew VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Flaaffy, Power Tablet, Training Court, Grass Energy and Fire Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Fusion Strike in November 2021.
